defaultPrompt: Use recognitio to build a verified review packet for this change.
interface.longDescription: Recognitio is an agent skill that assembles the evidence for a code review before the review begins. It reads a pull request or a commit range from the local clone and builds one review packet in four tiers, T0 Triage, T1 The change, T2 Companions and T3 History, and a closing recount receipt. A manifest records every changed file and hunk, and the packet is called verified only when an independent recount of the recorded change agrees with the manifest. Install it as a plugin or a skill in a supported agent host, then ask the host to build a packet for the change under review and hand the packet to the review. The marketplace also offers recognitio-mod, the spawn gate on its own, and the full plugin already includes that gate, so install one entry or the other and never both. Recognitio assembles evidence and nothing more. It does not judge the change, post comments, or approve anything, and it never builds a packet from a hosted diff, because hosted diffs cap their file counts and drop oversized patches without a flag. A packet whose verified flag is false is not reviewed as if it were whole. MIT licensed. Published by David Engelmann, with the source at github.com/david-engelmann/recognitio.
